shiki_spoken: Дзюн, мы организуем выборочный полный досмотр этого груза.
shiki_player_voluntary_action: Approaches the wagons from northern watchtower and orders Jun to arrange selected full inspection of caravan medical cargo. Does not choose medical treatment, scan, fighting, concealment or other speech. No Shiki inner state or feelings invented.

timeflow.event: Local border Chunin Нагасэ Дзюн accepts Shiki order and relays hand signs to 4 Kusa guards below: temporarily hold convoy exit, prepare proper customs group, no weapons without grounds, no handling medical items barehanded. Shiki descends and comes close to suspicious wagon2 without activating chakra.

Woman manifest keeper gives name Минасэ Тиё, medical transport coordinator, claims temperature requirement and requests documented careful handling. Jun introduces 20yo Jonin Mugami Shiki with official search powers. One trained escort with broken nose adjusts rear foot to fighting position but leaves hands visible; a different escort backs away and seems relieved when legal inspection ordered. Tiyo watches Shiki's near-absent facial cues, jaw tight, tries to assess whether threat or impatience, finds no overt signal. Effect of Shiki's eerie composure causes varied psychological reactions, NOT magical, automatic compulsion or universal fear.

Physical inspection of wagon1 shows bandages saline liquids medical tools matching list; wagon3 contains medicinal herbs and storage equipment matching list. No obvious concealed compartment in first inspection. Other six armed escorts and 3 drivers remain at customs yard, no combat.

Wagon2 drawn by 4 horses contains three elongated dark metal chilled containers and a fourth larger central insulated case; fourth lacked individual number in cargo manifest. On lid a metallic ring recess similar to reader for Inaba M-4/031 plate (Shiki personally knew only patient description, not matched physical reader proof). Three rhythmical knocks, pause and three knocks sound within fourth case. Tiyo, visibly alarmed, insists open carefully. Two Kusa officers open case after paperwork/care checks under official inspection.

Fourth case contains CONSCIOUS roughly 25yo male on medical transport frame, thin blanket, assisted gas via soft breathing mask, wrists restrained with broad straps. Fresh surgical sutures on right forearm; metal wrist bracelet on LEFT with six small recesses FOUR filled with dark material, physically resembles pattern on Inaba tag but not identical ID proven. Left hand could move few centimeters to tap inner metal wall: observed source of knocks. Man looks at Shiki, then Tiyo, trying to speak through mask but only produces shallow breath. No diagnosis or proof whether consented to confinement. Woman says he is patient and treatment cannot be interrupted. No living passenger declared in manifest; tangible customs-document discrepancy. The escort with broken nose has visible impulse toward weapon but obeys Jun's order to keep hands visible.

Jun tells Shiki that there is now a factual basis to hold cargo for inspection, but transferring a medically unstable passenger without clinical check is dangerous. Jun awaits Shiki's next operational/medical decision.
